===Rewards===
*[[Desert amulet 4]]:
**Unlimited teleports to [[Nardah]], closer to the [[Elidinis Statuette]] than the previous amulets
**Unlimited teleports to the entrance of the [[Kalphite Cave]]
**Fully protects against [[desert heat]] while worn
*[[Antique lamp (elite)|Antique lamp]] worth 50,000 experience in any skill of at least level 70
*[[Pharaoh's sceptre]] will now hold up to 100 [[Pharaoh's sceptre#Recharging|charges]], up from 50
*Free passage through [[Shantay Pass]] and the similar pass at [[Ruins of Unkah]], down from a fee of 5 [[coins]]
*Access to the [[Crevice (Kalphite Lair)|crevice shortcut]] in the [[Kalphite Lair]] (with 86 [[Agility]])
